description:
A domain's off-page authority: domain rank (0–1000, higher = stronger), backlinks, referring domains, dofollow referring domains, spam score (0–100, higher = more links from spammy sites) and broken backlinks; a major reason competitors out-rank and out-cite a site. A workspace site or any domain (a competitor).

Billing: free. A workspace site's snapshot is cached on it for 24 h; other domains: 50 new lookups a day per workspace (repeats within 24 h don't count).

When to call: 'why do they outrank us', or to compare authority with a competitor. Which sites link (names, anchors): get_referring_domains (paid).

Returns { site_id (null for a non-workspace domain), target, rank, backlinks, referring_domains, dofollow_referring_domains, spam_score, broken_backlinks, note? }, or found: false when the index has no data. Errors: provider_unavailable (retry), rate_limited.

domain.description: Any domain, e.g. a competitor's. A workspace site's domain reads like site_id; with site_id, the domain to check instead of the site. Cached 24 h.

site_id.description: A workspace site (site_id from list_sites); its snapshot is cached on it for 24 h. Or pass domain.

name: get_backlink_summary
title: Get a domain's off-page authority (backlink summary)
